rules.name: token
rules.text:
token:
    keyword
    identifier
    constant
    string-literal
    punctuator
rules.sourceLiteral:
token:
    keyword
    identifier
    constant
    string-literal
    punctuator

rules.name: preprocessing-token
rules.text:
preprocessing-token:
    header-name
    identifier
    pp-number
    character-constant
    string-literal
    punctuator
    each universal-character-name that cannot be one of the above
    each non-white-space-character that cannot be one of the above
rules.sourceLiteral:
preprocessing-token:
    header-name
    identifier
    pp-number
    character-constant
    string-literal
    punctuator
    each universal-character-name that cannot be one of the above
    each non-white-space-character that cannot be one of the above

rules.name: constant
rules.text:
constant:
    integer-constant
    floating-constant
    enumeration-constant
    character-constant
    predefined-constant
rules.sourceLiteral:
constant:
    integer-constant
    floating-constant
    enumeration-constant
    character-constant

rules.name: primary-expression
rules.text:
primary-expression:
    identifier
    constant
    string-literal
    ( expression )
    generic-selection
rules.sourceLiteral:
primary-expression:
    identifier
    constant
    string-literal
    ( expression )
    generic-selection

rules.name: postfix-expression
rules.text:
postfix-expression:
    primary-expression
    postfix-expression [ expression ]
    postfix-expression ( argument-expression-list_opt )
    postfix-expression . identifier
    postfix-expression -> identifier
    postfix-expression ++
    postfix-expression --
    compound-literal
rules.sourceLiteral:
postfix-expression:

    postfix-expression [ expression ]
    postfix-expression ( argument-expression-list_opt )
    postfix-expression . identifier
    postfix-expression -> identifier
    postfix-expression ++
    postfix-expression --
    compound-literal

rules.name: unary-expression
rules.text:
unary-expression:
    postfix-expression
    ++ unary-expression
    -- unary-expression
    unary-operator cast-expression
    sizeof unary-expression
    sizeof ( type-name )
    alignof ( type-name )
rules.sourceLiteral:
unary-expression:
    postfix-expression
    ++ unary-expression
    -- unary-expression
    unary-operator cast-expression
    sizeof unary-expression
    sizeof ( type-name )
    alignof ( type-name )

rules.name: multiplicative-expression
rules.text:
multiplicative-expression:
    cast-expression
    multiplicative-expression * cast-expression
    multiplicative-expression / cast-expression
    multiplicative-expression % cast-expression
rules.sourceLiteral:
multiplicative-expression:
    cast-expression
    multiplicative-expression * cast-expression
    multiplicative-expression / cast-expression
    multiplicative-expression % cast-expression

rules.name: additive-expression
rules.text:
additive-expression:
    multiplicative-expression
    additive-expression + multiplicative-expression
    additive-expression - multiplicative-expression
rules.sourceLiteral:

    multiplicative-expression
    additive-expression + multiplicative-expression
    additive-expression - multiplicative-expression

rules.name: shift-expression
rules.text:
shift-expression:
    additive-expression
    shift-expression << additive-expression
    shift-expression >> additive-expression
rules.sourceLiteral:

    shift-expression >> additive-expression

rules.name: relational-expression
rules.text:
relational-expression:

    relational-expression > shift-expression

    relational-expression >= shift-expression

rules.name: equality-expression

    equality-expression != relational-expression

rules.name: selection-statement
rules.text:
selection-statement:
    if ( expression ) secondary-block
    if ( expression ) secondary-block else secondary-block
    switch ( expression ) secondary-block

rules.name: iteration-statement

iteration-statement:

    do secondary-block while ( expression ) ;
    for ( expression_opt ; expression_opt ; expression_opt ) secondary-block
    for ( declaration expression_opt ; expression_opt ) secondary-block
